name: io.github.wellknownmcp/hoshin-kanri
title: Hoshin Kanri X-Matrix
description: Strategic memory agents can build, score and keep current: a living X-Matrix with review cadences.

highlights: create_matrix, upsert_element and set_correlation: an agent builds a strategy from nothing, then keeps it current — no web form in the loop
get_cascade and set_matrix_parent: group, business-unit and site matrices linked, with what each level took up and what nobody did
16 tools + 9 guided prompts: idea inbox, theme deployment diagnosis, weekly execution sync (Linear/Jira via external_ref)
A completeness score that returns a verdict, not a dashboard: coverage, correlation density, orphan elements, vision-to-KPI chains, leading/lagging balance
matrix_artifact prompt renders a boardroom-ready interactive X-Matrix artifact
share_matrix publishes a revocable read-only public link
OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration - connects to claude.ai and Cursor in minutes
Sovereign local JSON mode available (data never leaves your machine)
